title: core-unit-bioinformatics/workflow-nxf-somatic-variantcomp pipeline - params.stratification schema
description: Tab-separated sheet of stratification BEDs (e.g. GIAB genome stratifications). Relative paths are resolved against the sheet's directory.

name.errorMessage: Stratification name must be provided and may only contain A-Z, a-z, 0-9 and '_' (it becomes a column name)

bed.errorMessage: Stratification BED must have extension '.bed' or '.bed.gz'
